beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I'm checking whether you remembered the same four.

beats.text: You don't need to carry all that.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I know. That's what makes it more generous.

beats.action: I move the longer chore list within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: I was just trying to help.

beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: I can carry it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Oh, now? After it's learned the shape of my shoulder?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then you appreciate the value of these thirty minutes.

beats.action: I move the task balance sheet within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. This pan has dried cheese. The exchange rate has changed.

beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And your release is coming along beautifully. Sit down while I review it.

beats.text: I disagreed with an idea.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. We update procedures as responsibilities become unpleasant.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Now take it back; I'm checking something other than distance.

beats.text: But you just asked me to bring it here.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And now we discover whether that was a one-time achievement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the empty chair within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Tell the room the authority passes to me now.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then saying I'm in charge should require very little imagination.

beats.text: This problem began with your order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Which is why my corrective order is so well informed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the unsigned order within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: These erased letters look like your initials.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Let's spend our attention on the much clearer letters in my solution.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I'd like to see today's work. One of those is more urgent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. It contains information that would make today's simple job complicated.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Is the director resigning?

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Who made it safe for you to make that decision?

beats.text: My name is right there.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Yes. Whose name would you mention if this went wrong?

beats.text: You were voted out of it.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I gave the vote a practical opportunity to express itself.

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: You're moving backward.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Influence needs a running start.

beats.text: There's no signature.

beats.text: That is your own stamp.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Good. Then we've identified the approving authority.

beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the ranked contributions within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: We're all helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Of course. I'm simply recording the order in which we'd collapse without us.

beats.action: I move the suggestion list within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Helpfulness is good, but who was most essential?

beats.text: I've got everyone covered. So many problems must mean they trust my power.

beats.text: They've cut your budget again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. They clearly expect me to achieve the impossible. Recognition at last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the restricted badge within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: You've lost access to two rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Which makes the remaining room my undisputed headquarters.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And thank you for saving us the delay of choosing badly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the strict instruction within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. I'm grateful for your flexibility about having no alternative.

beats.text: I didn't agree to this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I appreciate how honestly you're beginning your cooperation.

beats.speaker: B

beats.action: I move the key and IOU within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Access costs a favour I can name later.

beats.text: Can't I just go through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. You can. We'll decide what you owe once you've enjoyed the access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the useful introduction within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. One approval buys one introduction; let's be precise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if I have nothing to offer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then we can admire the closed door together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the support chart within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. I'll record that as agreement with my leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only nodded at the date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Exactly. A leadership programme needs a date. You've approved the foundation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the unanimous notice within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Your agreement on the date confirms the whole plan under me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I objected to half of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Which leaves an uncontested half for my announcement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.action: I move the boundary drawing within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. That affects my area, so I'll need to control this part too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The kitchen isn't your department.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. It supplies my department's tea. That's a strategic connection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the growing keyring within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. One more responsibility requires one more room under my authority.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you need the roof key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Rain reaches my window. I need oversight at the source.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.text: You could hire someone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I could. They wouldn't remember why this table matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the unfinished job within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Help with this one thing so I know we're still connected.

beats.text: I'm not good at this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then stay beside me and be bad at it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: We already finished cleaning.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The room is tidy. I'm asking about us.

beats.action: I move the empty sink within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. The dishes are done, but we haven't settled what happened between us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's nothing left to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then we finally have time to say whether we're okay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.action: I move the unused ticket within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: I said I was sorry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Tell me what you think I did while the seat stayed empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the unread message within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Tell me you understand why that silence hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My phone died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I'm asking what it felt like on my side, not what happened to the battery.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Why aren't you celebrating?

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I'm waiting to learn whether this is good news to both of us.

beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: You know more about this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I know enough to be tired. Take one page because you're here with me.

beats.text: I didn't pack it.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Neither did I, alone. That second handle is part of the relationship.

beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: Just write my name.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. There's a box after the name. I keep looking at that box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the seating plan within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. That's what strangers say when they don't want to commit to a table.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: I remember it differently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Could your memory stand beside mine while they're all listening?

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the note recording our disputed promise within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Take my side about what that promise meant.

beats.text: You left out what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. We'll add my part after they understand why your part supports me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.action: I move the private note within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.

beats.text: Someone might read it.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then say the sentence to me instead of leaving it on paper.

beats.text: It's just a picture.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then say what you remember before I let it become just paper.

beats.text: You keep everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Only the things I need someone else to confirm mattered.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.text: This opportunity won't come twice.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Neither will tonight. I've already set your place.

beats.text: It's important.

beats.text: I don't remember which you like.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. That's all right. It is only something I told you every morning.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The part you used to interrupt me to tell yourself.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Because carrying it takes the hand I'd like you to offer me.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And look at this lovely blank stationery where we could start again.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Locks age. Could we talk about how nice it is to have you back?

beats.text: Where were you for six months?

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Did we still like the same soup six months ago?

beats.text: That's the day you disappeared.

beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And such impossible sunshine. Look at the shadows.

beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Every problem started with that cup, not my hand beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hand knocked it over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Let's not let one hand distract us from that ominous opening cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the first question on the clipboard within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it was raining.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked about your mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And before that you asked about the rain. I'm being thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the lunch form within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Before your question about my mistake, let me finish discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've finished discussing lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I hadn't mentioned the soup. An incomplete answer would be rude.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the folded pages within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. There was a small change; I'll explain how small once you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How small a change?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The date is the smallest part. Let's finish tea before the venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the gentler account within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. When I said postponed, I meant the original event won't return unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does unchanged mean?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The invitation still has our names. That's the part we can hold onto first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the half admission within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. I changed the time; yours is the only missing piece of the story now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why tell me only half?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Because the second half is sitting in your envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the small confession within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. I hid the first letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you hid the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The first. I'm offering that truth so you can place yours beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the failed result within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. That strange noise was the turning point, not a warning I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the strange noise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I treated it as foreshadowing. Now its significance is wonderfully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the old sketch within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. The ending was foreshadowed here; the plan needed this reversal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plan collapsed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Exactly at the point this drawing becomes interesting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the vague prediction within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. When I said 'a change', I obviously meant this precise disaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. I said things would flow differently. Read with professional imagination.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the wrong forecast within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Read it metaphorically and you'll see I was right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. An emotional forecast. The umbrellas represent personal growth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the renamed score column within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Fewest points means greatest self-control; I've won that category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You came last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. In speed. First in refusing to rush the experience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the tiny trophy within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Size measures insecurity now, so this is the better prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. For whoever needs a large trophy. I'm delighted with my superior restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the hopeful drawing within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. We wanted a place to belong; even this wreck can become that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The place is wrecked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. But we drew somewhere for us, not somewhere already perfect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the first promise on paper within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. We're still making that hope real, just in a larger shape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before everything failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Then let's make the promise large enough to include the wreckage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the wrapped cup within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Take this for whenever you remember these afternoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you giving me this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. So you won't have to come back just to remember tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the straightened coat within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. You'll do beautifully wherever the next door opens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Only the sort that hopes your next doorway fits you better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the two prices within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. The lift costs petrol and the conversation we've been avoiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And we'll talk during the drive. That's the part I couldn't put on the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the bill and photograph within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Pay for the repair in money, and for the silence in honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why charge for silence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Because money repairs the chair. Honesty repairs why I broke it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the quoted agreement within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. I promised to carry a box, not whichever box you point at forever.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. With a box. That was before you gave the warehouse a name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the underlined today within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Yes, I said today; tomorrow wasn't included in those words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow is practically the same.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. Not to the sentence we both agreed to yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the cup, note, and key within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Every little choice has brought us to this locked door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How are those connected?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. The cup hid the note, the note asked for the key, and now neither of us can leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I move the napkin with our returning joke within everyone's reach while hiding my shaking hand.
beats.text: I've got everyone covered. Remember saying nothing could go wrong? Look at what we're carrying now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was only a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can handle the difficult calls as well. And now you're holding its three separate consequences. Which one do we solve first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who is taking care of you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll put that on the list after the people currently asking.
